title: Business Ethics
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Jim announces his engagement to Pam, sparking mixed reactions in the office. Holly leads a business ethics seminar addressing misconduct, including Meredith's unethical relationship with a supplier in exchange for discounts. Holly faces resistance and suspicion as she enforces ethics policies, while Michael shows sympathy toward Meredith despite the serious issues. The episode explores workplace ethics, conflicts, and the challenges of enforcing moral standards in a close-knit office environment.
